selected.look_here_first: Look for felted, softly hairy leaves, the five-petaled mallow flower and mallow-style staminal column; compare mericarp fruits.
Recognize a tiny free-floating fern mat of overlapping, scale-like paired leaves, often reddish; check roots beneath the water surface.
Find leafless twining parasitic orange or yellow strands on a host plant; inspect clusters of minute flowers, calyces and capsules.
Inspect wiry stems, narrow leaves and widely separated, delicate racemes; check spikelet hairs and arrangement under magnification.
Look for aquatic or wet-ground rosettes with long leaf stalks and three-petaled flowers in whorls; examine flattened achenes.
Look for a low, broomlike shrub of jointed green photosynthetic stems with leaves reduced to minute scales; examine seed cones.
Look for branching herbaceous stems and the tiny clustered cyathia; inspect their cup-shaped involucres, glands and three-lobed capsules.
Recognize a low stolon-forming grass with short curled leaf blades; inspect the distinctive short terminal inflorescences and spikelets.
Look for a climbing vine with tendrils and lobed leaves; examine small unisexual flowers and bright mature gourdlike fruits.
Find an intricately branched shrub with narrow leaves and unusual pinkish-purple flowers; inspect modified petals and beaked woody fruit.
Begin with opposite, deeply dissected leaves and tiny axillary flowers; check the hairy stems and seed capsules.
Look for slender stems bearing narrow simple leaves and five-petaled yellow flowers; check sepals and the developing five-part capsule.
Look for wetland fern leaves with four wedge-shaped leaflets like a clover; identify stalked beanlike sporocarps for confirmation.
Check the low creeping mat, toothed opposite leaves and small yellow five-lobed flowers; inspect corolla throat and seed capsules.
Inspect opposite narrow to variably shaped leaves, yellow flowers with a short tube and mature paired fruit; check floral lobes.
